summary: Example ~/.ssh/config defines the jump host and a ProxyCommand per device with the explicit NETCONF port (22 or 830) since paramiko doesn't use ansible_port. SSH won't take passwords via env vars, so prefer SSH keys and an agent.
questions: What should my ssh config look like for NETCONF via a jump host?
Why must I hard-code the NETCONF port in ProxyCommand?
Can I pass an SSH password through ProxyCommand?

answer_card.title: SSH config for NETCONF via jump host
answer_card.answer_md:
```text
Host jumphost
  HostName jumphost.domain.name.com
  User jumphost-user
  IdentityFile "/path/to/ssh-key.pem"

Host junos01
  HostName junos01
  ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:830 jumphost   # or %h:22
```
Paramiko doesn't use `ansible_port` here, so put the actual NETCONF port in `ProxyCommand`. SSH can't take passwords from environment variables (to avoid leaks in `ps`), so use SSH keys and ssh-agent.
